config.original:
global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m
  http_config:
    follow_redirects: true
    enable_http2: true
  smtp_from: alertmanager@nexify.ai
  smtp_hello: localhost
  smtp_smarthost: localhost:587
  smtp_require_tls: true
  smtp_tls_config:
    insecure_skip_verify: false
  slack_api_url: <secret>
  slack_app_url: https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage
  pagerduty_url: https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue
  opsgenie_api_url: https://api.opsgenie.com/
  wechat_api_url: https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/
  victorops_api_url: https://alert.victorops.com/integrations/generic/20131114/alert/
  telegram_api_url: https://api.telegram.org
  webex_api_url: https://webexapis.com/v1/messages
  rocketchat_api_url: https://open.rocket.chat/
route:
  receiver: slack-default
  group_by:
  - alertname
  - job
  - namespace
  continue: false
  routes:
  - receiver: slack-critical-pagerduty
    match:
      severity: critical
    continue: false
    group_wait: 10s
    group_interval: 1m
    repeat_interval: 30m
  - receiver: slack-default
    match:
      severity: warning
    continue: false
    group_wait: 30s
    repeat_interval: 4h
  - receiver: slack-default
    match:
      severity: info
    continue: false
    group_wait: 5m
    repeat_interval: 12h
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
inhibit_rules:
- source_match:
    severity: critical
  target_match:
    severity: warning
  equal:
  - alertname
  - instance
- source_match:
    severity: warning
  target_match:
    severity: info
  equal:
  - alertname
  - instance
receivers:
- name: slack-default
  labels:
    name: slack-default
  slack_configs:
  - send_resolved: true
    http_config:
      follow_redirects: true
      enable_http2: true
    api_url: <secret>
    app_url: https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage
    channel: '#nexify-alerts'
    username: '{{ template "slack.default.username" . }}'
    color: '{{ if eq .Status "firing" }}danger{{ else }}good{{ end }}'
    title: '{{ .CommonLabels.alertname }} [{{ .Status | toUpper }}]'
    title_link: '{{ template "slack.default.titlelink" . }}'
    pretext: '{{ template "slack.default.pretext" . }}'
    text: '{{ range .Alerts }} *Alert:* {{ .Annotations.summary }} *Severity:* {{
      .Labels.severity }} *Instance:* {{ .Labels.instance }} *Description:* {{ .Annotations.description
      }} *Started:* {{ .StartsAt }} {{ if .EndsAt }}*Ended:* {{ .EndsAt }}{{ end }}
      {{ end }}'
    short_fields: false
    footer: '{{ template "slack.default.footer" . }}'
    fallback: '{{ template "slack.default.fallback" . }}'
    callback_id: '{{ template "slack.default.callbackid" . }}'
    icon_emoji: '{{ template "slack.default.iconemoji" . }}'
    icon_url: '{{ template "slack.default.iconurl" . }}'
    link_names: false
    actions:
    - type: button
      text: 'Silence Alert :bell:'
      url: '{{ .ExternalURL }}/#/silences/new?filter=%7Balertname%3D%22{{ .CommonLabels.alertname
        }}%22%7D'
    update_message: false
    timeout: 0s
- name: slack-critical-pagerduty
  labels:
    name: slack-critical-pagerduty
  pagerduty_configs:
  - send_resolved: true
    http_config:
      follow_redirects: true
      enable_http2: true
    service_key: <secret>
    url: https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue
    client: '{{ template "pagerduty.default.client" . }}'
    client_url: '{{ template "pagerduty.default.clientURL" . }}'
    description: '{{ .CommonAnnotations.summary }}'
    details:
      firing: '{{ .Alerts.Firing | toJson }}'
      num_firing: '{{ .Alerts.Firing | len }}'
      num_resolved: '{{ .Alerts.Resolved | len }}'
      resolved: '{{ .Alerts.Resolved | toJson }}'
    source: '{{ template "pagerduty.default.client" . }}'
    severity: '{{ if eq .CommonLabels.severity "critical" }}critical{{ else }}warning{{
      end }}'
    component: '{{ .CommonLabels.job }}'
    group: '{{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}'
    timeout: 0s
  slack_configs:
  - send_resolved: true
    http_config:
      follow_redirects: true
      enable_http2: true
    api_url: <secret>
    app_url: https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage
    channel: '#nexify-alerts-critical'
    username: '{{ template "slack.default.username" . }}'
    color: danger
    title: ':rotating_light: CRITICAL: {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }} [{{ .Status |
      toUpper }}]'
    title_link: '{{ template "slack.default.titlelink" . }}'
    pretext: '{{ template "slack.default.pretext" . }}'
    text: '{{ range .Alerts }} :fire: *CRITICAL ALERT* *Alert:* {{ .Annotations.summary
      }} *Severity:* {{ .Labels.severity }} *Instance:* {{ .Labels.instance }} *Job:*
      {{ .Labels.job }} *Description:* {{ .Annotations.description }} *Started:* {{
      .StartsAt }} {{ end }}'
    short_fields: false
    footer: '{{ template "slack.default.footer" . }}'
    fallback: '{{ template "slack.default.fallback" . }}'
    callback_id: '{{ template "slack.default.callbackid" . }}'
    icon_emoji: '{{ template "slack.default.iconemoji" . }}'
    icon_url: '{{ template "slack.default.iconurl" . }}'
    link_names: false
    actions:
    - type: button
      text: 'Silence Alert :bell:'
      url: '{{ .ExternalURL }}/#/silences/new?filter=%7Balertname%3D%22{{ .CommonLabels.alertname
        }}%22%7D'
    update_message: false
    timeout: 0s
templates: []
